note: Transcribed with AI assistance (Gemini) from the photos of the official list and corrected by hand. Grade 12 rank-1 names follow the published text report where the photo reading differed: គង់ រតនធីតា (photo reading: គង់ រតនាធិតា); ជេត ឆវីវណ្ណ (photo reading: ដេត ឆរីវណ្ណ). Not legible in the photos: grade 9 physics has 8 of 10 ranks. The text report says girls won 11 of the 18 top-3 places; this transcription gives 12, so a gender may be misread. Awaiting a full check against the originals.
